name: Disneyland Gibson Girl Hand-Scooped Vanilla Ice Cream Dish (Seed-Free Sweet)
brandOrRestaurant: Gibson Girl Ice Cream Parlor (Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Single scoop of smooth Dreyer's vanilla ice cream served in a cup. Completely seed-free, nut-free, and refreshing on a warm park afternoon.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a single scoop of vanilla or chocolate ice cream in a dish (pass on strawberry sundaes with berry seeds).
watchOuts: Contains dairy cream; take lactase enzyme tablet if lactose sensitive
